corridor_width_definition: surface-to-surface nominal free gap between the two box inner X faces
planning_variable: isotropic planning-time obstacle inflation; every surface expands outward by inflation_mm

fixed_gate_region.opening_bounds_rule: x=center_x +/- corridor_width/2; active z span equals nominal post z span
fixed_gate_region.local_evaluation_rule: trajectory states whose panda_hand y is within +/- 0.04 m of the fixed gate plane

physx_role: independent nominal collision validation; positive contact-report separation is auxiliary, not arbitrary-distance ground truth
canonical_run_policy: calibration run 1; never selected by timing, length, or route result
